mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05% over the prior 30 days, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.1%, it indicates emergency monetary policy response that triggers liquidity injections and positive equity market returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market contraction (UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% over 3 months), the combination signals deteriorating economic conditions that drive negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During recession (GDPC1 growth < 0% over 3 months), rising housing starts (HOUST) signals sectoral recovery that precedes positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is negative and HOUST rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply shock reducing corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to profit contraction.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by at least 1.0% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real sales (RSAFS) reflects weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market weakness (PAYEMS growth < 0.3% over 3 months) and ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%), the joint signal anticipates fiscal stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 3% annually), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL growth > 3% (12mo) and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.05% over the prior month.
